richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Rampur

c: Senior citizens are often the first to use a new open gym in a town like Rampur, so we plan for them from the start. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor fitness equipment to parks, schools and residential colonies in Rampur, in the Rohilkhand plains of western Uttar Pradesh. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,220 km away, and sent by road.

Gentle, low-impact machines let older users move their joints without strain, and the same stations still give younger people a useful workout. We install through our team or a dealer in north India. Before manufacturing, you get a layout drawing that shows each machine and the clear space around it, so the committee can review it and suggest changes. Nothing is manufactured until you are happy with the plan.
In our experience, older users prefer machines with a seat or a firm handhold. The

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines are safest for elderly users?
items.a: Low-impact machines with seats or firm handles, such as seated twisters, Tai Chi wheels and walkers. Users should still move at their own pace and stop if anything feels uncomfortable.

items.q: Can you send a layout before we order?
items.a: Yes. Once you share the area size and photos, we send a layout drawing with each machine and its clear space marked. You approve it before we manufacture.

items.q: Do the machines need power or adjustment?
items.a: No power is needed. The machines work on body weight and simple movement, and they have no settings to change between users. That makes them easy for first-time users to pick up.
